python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)
monthly_values = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

# Calculate Mean Absolute Deviation
mean = statistics.mean(monthly_values)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

mad = statistics.mean([abs(x - mean) for x in monthly_values])
print(f"MAD: {mad}")

# Round to thousandths place
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
EOF

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)
# From column "Net excise taxes (35)" in the table
monthly_values = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

# Calculate sum
total = sum(monthly_values)
print(f"Sum: {total}")

# Number of months
n = len(monthly_values)
print(f"Number of months: {n}")

# Calculate mean
mean = total / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate absolute deviations
abs_deviations = [abs(x - mean) for x in monthly_values]
print(f"\nAbsolute deviations: {abs_deviations}")

# Calculate MAD
mad = sum(abs_deviations) / n
print(f"\nMean Absolute Deviation (MAD): {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
EOF
